answers.explanation: User programs run in user mode; the OS runs in kernel mode.
Setting the timer and I/O control are privileged.
Privileged instructions only run in kernel mode.
The system call is the controlled doorway into kernel mode and back.
So the OS is in control whenever anything important happens.
Ordinary arithmetic is harmless, so any program can do it.
VMM mode is more privileged than a guest's kernel.
